model.title: Strategic Grazing to Reduce Risk of Wildfire Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Catherine Cortez Masto (D-NV)

summary.text: The bill would require the federal government to use livestock grazing as a tool to reduce wildfire risk on public lands managed by the Agriculture and Interior departments. It aims to leverage grazing animals to clear vegetation that could fuel dangerous wildfires.
